description: Route completeness check. Every mobile *Routes enum member and every desktop/web route from routeConfig, with how it is rendered, the screen-audit ledger features, runtime screenshots and capture flows that reach it.

status_rules.covered: has ledger features and at least one screenshot (feature intersection or capture flow arrival)
status_rules.features-only: has features (ledger or implementation evidence), no screenshot
status_rules.unmapped: no feature in any ledger or feature implementation evidence for the rendering component
status_rules.internal: ledger disposition excluded-internal/internal-reference, or a development route name (mobile /DevUtils|MessageSystem|AppsEmbedding|Storybook|Debug/, desktop /debug|embedding|storybook/)
status_rules.alias: renders the same component as an earlier route: desktop non-nested routes sharing a page component; mobile routes sharing a component within one navigator
status_rules.navigator: mobile only: the registered component is a nested navigator whose screens are separate records
status_rules.unregistered: mobile only: enum member with no `<X.Screen>` registration in app source
